descriptionMarkdown:
3.5 Squat / Kin
Squats, often known as Kin in modern Imperial records, 
are hardy void-adapted abhumans associated
with holds, guilds, oath-bands, mining fleets, mercenary 
contracts, and ancient grudges. They are
shorter than humans but dense, resilient, technically 
minded, and extremely difficult to intimidate.
Ability Scores: +2 Constitution, +1 Intelligence or 
Wisdom.
Size: Medium, but your height is usually between 4 and 5 
ft.
Speed: 25 ft.
Available Classes: Kin Armsman, Hernkyn Prospector.
3.5.1 Squat / Kin Traits
Darkvision: You have darkvision to a range of 60 ft (see 
the rules at the start of this chapter).
Dense Build: You have advantage on saving throws 
against being shoved, knocked prone, or moved
against your will.
Void-Hardened: You have advantage on saving throws 
against exhaustion caused by poor atmosphere,
bad rations, forced marches, cramped voidship 
conditions, mining hazards, or environmental hardship.
Guild-Craft: Gain proficiency in Technology, 
Investigation, or one artisan/tool proficiency related to
engineering, mining, weapons, armour, or voidcraft.
Grudge Memory: Once per long rest, when a creature 
damages you or an ally within 30 ft, mark that
creature as the subject of a grudge. The first time you hit 
that creature before the end of the encounter,
add your proficiency bonus to the damage.
Stubborn Kin: You have advantage on saving throws 
against being frightened.
